digest.component_or_area: rebar._store.push — tickets branch best-effort push logging
propositions: Expected and auto-handled best-effort push failures (lost contention races, transient transport retries, routine unpushed backlog) surface at WARNING/INFO and prime LLM agents to assume the store is broken and investigate, burning tokens on non-issues
Mid-retry transient transport notices and static backlog counts are currently emitted at INFO or above despite being retried automatically and not indicating operator-actionable outage
Backlog suffix messages display bare `..HEAD` (reader interprets as code worktree HEAD, not tracker HEAD) and do not state the self-healing contract (commits publish on next successful push)

Policy declines (hook rejected, branch protection, GH013), strict-mode failures, and proven-growing backlog must remain WARNING/raise as operator-actionable signals, distinguishable from routine contention

Expected-case push outcomes must emit NOTHING at INFO or above (DEBUG at most) with explicit branch name, self-healing contract, and "no action needed" wording; loud cases (policy, strict, proven growth) unchanged
